complexity.rationale: Short source still warrants extended review because multi-repository/tool authority and source-role distinctions interact.

sourceCoverage.rationale: Complete machine transcript covers five substantive chapters and six creator navigation markers. Opening anecdote and closing course promotion do not become evidence; chapter cues are not verbatim time certification.

supportingArgument.rationale: Separates shared steering/versioning, pointers and worktrees, scale disclosure, monorepo preference and connected tooling while preserving project ownership.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Creator article and video are related attribution sources. Git and Anthropic documentation support mechanisms, not measured home-repo outcomes or universally identical harness behavior.

counterargument.rationale: Central maps can become stale duplicate instruction stores and broad tool catalogs can increase noise or access exposure. Existing per-repo workflow remains a reasonable fallback.

tradeoffs.rationale: Shared maintenance and discovery benefit must be balanced against staleness, harness differences, permission concentration and ownership visibility; no automatic central migration is recommended.

falsifiability.rationale: Proposes one matched authorized task with consistent model/revisions/permissions and observations of repo choice, retrieved instructions, scope, review effort and owner interventions. Proposal is not executed evidence.

originalSynthesis.rationale: A shared map and knowledge layer can aid navigation while destination-level authority, CI, owners and revocation stay independently enforceable.

performance.rationale: No controlled completion-rate or security improvement is established by creator walkthrough. The proposed trial measures operational outcomes rather than asserting a payoff.

economics.rationale: Reduced duplicate maintenance and irrelevant context are plausible benefits, but no measured cost savings are asserted. Review effort and stale guidance can offset any benefit.

threatGovernance.rationale: Connected tools and repositories preserve service credentials, delegated scope, review and downstream permission checks. File discoverability is never treated as action authority.

gaps.rationale: Independent reviewer accepts exact candidate for owner review only. Owner graph disposition and final publication authorization remain pending; no owner decision is fabricated.
Source captions may contain recognition errors; full listening, visual-demo reproduction and independent performance replication were not performed.

decisionRationale: Qualitative review accepts for owner consideration; release remains held for explicit owner decisions and authentic receipt integration. Optional Work comparison is a proposal, not a required new scope expansion.
